items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: His real name was Kirnon. ... his name was really Conrad Kirnon.

ctx.x: I’ve been asking you about this, so I wanna take a brief time. What do you know about Connie Kay’s family? I don’t know anything about them. Who did he marry? What were his sons’ names?
You asked me about that. Rodney was born around the time… His wife is Addie Kirnon. His real name was Kirnon.
